reader.notes: PresentLine sets LINE-COUNTER to the target before composing the line and writes it with the advance that reaches the target; PresentBody takes the page advance of a NEXT PAGE line before presenting it. Probes at --std 85 show every line on its computed line with LINE-COUNTER equal to it.

refuter.evidence: i1_nextpage_first_generate (LINE 5 ON NEXT PAGE): first GENERATE prints D 05 on page 1 with no advance (1985 XIII.3.10.8 GR3c: no body group yet, no saved next group), second advances and prints D 05 on page 2; i2_abs_behind_lc (absolute 4 and 6, LC 6 at the second GENERATE): page advance, then D 04 and E 06; i3_rf_next_page (RF LINE 3 ON NEXT PAGE, PLUS 2): RF 03, RG 05 on a new page; i4_first_rel_zero (a detail whose first LINE clause is PLUS 0): Z 03 on the previous body group's line 3; i5_unpaged_rel (no PAGE clause): D 02, E 03, D 05, E 06; i6_cf_lc: CF 08. Every SOURCE LINE-COUNTER shows the line it is printed on, so positioning precedes presentation for absolute, relative, relative zero, NEXT PAGE, an RF and an unpaged report.
